# CampaignPro

> CampaignPro is an independent Google Ads management service for small and medium businesses in the United States and Canada. It has managed more than $25 million in Google Ads spend since 2019. Management is a flat fee from $1,000 per month (not a percentage of ad spend), month-to-month with no contract and no setup fee. Businesses already running Google Ads get a free account audit; new advertisers get free account setup.

CampaignPro is run by a single Google Ads specialist, so clients work directly with the person managing their account, without account managers or outsourced teams.

## Key facts

- Service: Google Ads campaign management, Google Ads account audits, conversion tracking and reporting
- Who it is for: small and medium businesses that need leads, including home and local services (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, cleaning), law firms, restaurants, independent professional services and other service businesses
- Area served: United States and Canada
- Price: from $1,000 per month, flat fee; ad spend is paid directly to Google
- Contract: month-to-month, cancel anytime, no setup fee
- Minimum ad budget: no fixed minimum; clients can start testing from about $500 per month in ad spend
- Track record: more than $25M in ad spend managed since 2019; across client accounts, cost per lead dropped 27% on average in the first 90 days
- Example results: one lead generation account tripled leads (8.4K to 25K) and cut cost per lead 41% ($2.92 to $1.72) while ad spend rose 76% (Jul–Dec 2024 vs. the previous period); another grew leads 129% and cut cost per lead 18% while spend rose 88%
- How to start: book a free strategy call at https://www.campaignpro.click/#booking
